The '''12-4C-41/b''' was a stripped down model of the [[12-4C-41 traffic control droid]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had limited [[Droid brain/Legends|cognitive modules]] and were substantially cheaper than the traffic control model. Their primary purpose was to act as mobile [[Portable beacon|landing beacons]] for incoming [[Starship/Legends|ships]], with multiple units using their [[zero-gee maneuvering jet]]s to position themselves in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The in-built landing beacon in their bodies would then be used to illuminate approach vectors and pathways for vessels to follow.<ref name="EGTD" />
